title.justification: The title "Towards Reliable Neural Specifications" directly reflects the main focus of the paper which is on improving the reliability of neural network specifications through new methodologies.

extractions.description: The paper presents a new family of neural network specifications, called neural representation as specification, that uses neural activation patterns (NAPs) instead of data to verify the correctness and robustness of neural networks. This is proposed as a more reliable method for verification compared to traditional data-as-specification approaches, addressing issues such as overfitting and limited verifiable input regions. The method involves mining neural activation patterns, which are sets of neuron activations expected in inputs of the same class, and uses these for robust verification of large input regions. The effectiveness of NAPs is demonstrated on datasets like MNIST and CIFAR10, showing improved robustness verification.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the reliability and verification of neural network specifications, which, while important for the integrity of AI applications, does not directly align with the eco-responsible categories related to climate change, pollution, or sustainability.
primary_category.quote: Having reliable specifications is an unavoidable challenge in achieving verifiable correctness, robustness, and interpretability of AI systems.

primary_sub_category.justification: The core contribution of the paper is the development of a new method for specifying and verifying the robustness of neural networks, which does not correspond to any specific eco-responsible sub-category defined in our current hierarchical list.
primary_sub_category.quote: We propose a new family of specifications, neural representation as specification.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's content is more aligned with AI robustness and verification than directly addressing eco-responsible themes.
new_primary_category.quote: This unique advantage of using NAPs as specification is enabled by the intrinsic information (or neural representation) embedded in the neural network model.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no immediate sub-category relevant to eco-responsibility that fits the paper's focus on AI verification and specification methodologies.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We propose a new family of specifications, neural representation as specification, where neural activation patterns form specifications.
